name: ayso13-redirects
description: Cloudflare Worker that handles 570+ legacy URL redirects in front of the AYSO Region 13 Cloudflare Pages site. Source of truth is site/src/_redirects; the build script parses that file and emits src/map.js for the Worker bundle.

scripts.preflight:
node -e 'if(!process.env.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID){console.error("
✗ CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID is not set.

Wrangler may deploy to the wrong Cloudflare account on this machine.
Export the AYSO Region 13 account ID first, e.g.:

  export CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=<ayso13-account-id>

Find it in the Cloudflare dashboard sidebar.
");process.exit(1)}else{console.log("✓ CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID is set")}'
scripts.dev: npm run preflight && npm run build && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run preflight && npm run build && npm test && wrangler deploy
